ct-sentences: tex 1805-1807, "Thus the threshold three is a limit of this method in these cases, not a proof that the unrestricted GL_2 or EL_3 conclusions are false."; a remark on the method; the mathematics it summarizes is carried by the ct-rank-two-limit rows.
